name: hermes-deps
description: Hermes Agent unified dependency zone. Hosts the bat/ps1 env entry points that every script dot-sources first, plus the version manifest for the runtime assets that bin/setup-portable.bat downloads. See README.md for layout. NOTE: this directory MUST NOT contain any directory junctions -- earlier versions did (deps/node/, deps/tools/, deps/llamacpp/bin/, deps/python-test/) but those stored absolute reparse-point targets and broke when the project was moved to a new drive letter (E: -> F:). The canonical paths are runtime/node23/ and runtime/llama-server.exe; modules/*/module.json was updated to reference those directly. Any leftover junction is auto-rmdir'd by deps/hermes-env.{bat,ps1} Step 3.

notes: Node.js 23.11.1 win-x64 zip is downloaded (no npm install -g is run).
The hermes-web-ui npm package is NOT bundled -- it is a sibling private repo
that the user must clone into .\hermes-web-ui\ or install manually. If absent,
modules/webui/start.ps1 falls back to the dev source under .\hermes-web-ui\.

changes: bin/setup-portable.bat: added [3/4] Node.js download step. Downloads node-v23.11.1-win-x64.zip from nodejs.org (~30 MB) into runtime/node23/.
Added 'bin/setup-portable.bat node' subcommand for node-only installs.
Added status-mode check for runtime/node23/node.exe (now reports present/MISSING in status output).

Fixed cmd.exe chained IF bug in :check_runtime status block: 'if not exist A if not exist B (else)' silently fell through; rewrote as nested IF so the status branch correctly reports 'present' vs 'MISSING'.

Moved 'node23/' from runtime.components into its own manifest_schema section 'runtime_node23' (with source URL + required_by + notes), since Node.js is now an independent download step rather than part of the runtime/ llama bundle.
hermes-web-ui npm package is intentionally NOT bundled by setup-portable.bat; users clone it into .\hermes-web-ui\ and the webui module falls back to that dev source if the global install is absent.
Updated bin/fix-eol.py comments: now references runtime/node_modules/ + runtime/cuda/<v>/ as the third-party LF locations, instead of the deleted junction paths.
Updated deps/README.md: explicitly forbids recreating the four legacy junctions; documents the canonical runtime/* paths.
Added 'canonical_paths' section to this manifest so consumers can audit the one true location of node.exe + llama-server.exe.
First commit of deps/ to git (previously local-only).

Removed dependency on the four `deps\node` / `deps\tools` / `deps\llamacpp\bin` / `deps\python-test` directory junctions, which stored absolute reparse-point targets and broke when the project was moved to a new drive letter (E: -> F:).
Added an auto-heal step that rmdir's any leftover junction under deps\ -- old copies of the repo self-repair on first run.
